title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Leader, I left a package at your door, so remember to scan and sign for it when you manage to pull your head out of that stack of documents! Huh, weird... didn't you delegate a whole bunch of work already? How are you even busier than before?

title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Cyan, wanna come with? The road ahead's filled with bad apples and worse people, but since you're such a fan of my lyre… just stick close to me.

title: Talk 1
original: A—Achoo! Wut? Sheesh, my sister just texted to check if I'm good. Nah, overempathy's a pain sometimes, you know? It feels like you've been living in my head, sis. I need some personal space, you know!

title: Talk 1
original: I made a bet with that crafty merchant, the one with the shield, that neither my lyre nor my voice would hold up until I sang the angels' tale to six hundred and sixty-six people. If she wins, the lyre's hers to keep, but if I win, she'll have to travel with me—Hah, whatcha think, Cyan? How are demons so silly?

title: Talk 2
original: Would I be sad if everyone couldn't stay together? Leader, you're overthinking it. Look at it this way: if we went our separate ways all across the lands, then I'd get to meet up with a friend anywhere I went, right? Keeps me on that logistics grind! And it's the perfect chance to throw a party!

title: Talk 2
original: In a swampy tavern, the flightless 'Emperor' stood atop broken bottle shards and declared: 'Paradise lost? Simply mold one from the mud!' Sheesh, that moved me more than any poem I'd ever heard.

title: Talk 3
original: How come the shop's still shuttered? Ahh... the disaster repairs will take too long, and everyone's going to need time to get used to the new empathy now that the Law's changed... who knows what the future's gonna be like? Ey, is that an ice cream truck I see? Leader, quick! After it! The future? It's right there, in the new flavor we're about to try!

title: Talk 3
original: The singer opened her mouth and all the clamoring dust turned to dew, like magic! I think a farewell ode to the statue is all I could've managed with my lyre. Well, should I drag her with us on our journey?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I always try to stay upbeat in a crowd, no matter the vibes. All the pain and sorrow stop right here with me, while I'll give out all the joy I have... Don't I get tired? Course not, I love hanging out.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Cyan, remember that quiet dragonslayer? I doodled a little flower on her sword when we left the tavern yesterday, so now she'll hear the lyre whenever she swings her blade. Nothing wrong with cutting a little loose, no matter what sort of quest you're on! What'cha looking at? She's headed our way? Let's skedaddle!

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Yep, I saw the Sankta 'Lord'. The Lord was talking about stuff like genesis, crisis, future... But eh, it's a whole thing, you know. Who's supposed to keep track of all that? I think the Lord's better off staying put in 'The Saints' Travels', and leaving the future for us to decide!

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: The dragon's snore, the elf's laughter… even the wind is no more, wonders of the land all gone from collective memory—Cyan! I was being all serious, and you're trying to sneak off with my apple collection?! Not that one, it's my precious!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: You found my diploma?! Yeah, I could've become an intercity network expert for the Notarial Hall, or maybe a mobile confessional designer, if I hadn't run off. Do I have any regrets? Duh! But dwelling on them is pointless. If I hadn't joined Penguin Logistics or met you—Nope, not thinking about it!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I probably would've melted into the dark that night, if you hadn't licked me awake. That's when I got this halo and wings too… huh? Wait, did I actually lose myself in the abyss, and you're a god who saved me? Hey, don't gnaw on my lyre! I was wrong, you're the cutest, fluffiest Cyan I know!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I didn't expect the halo to light up again after all that. Does it mean our Law and faith had nothing to do with it the whole time? I don't really get it, and we're stuck with it either way. There're no streetlights on our little path, so without the halo, we'd be smacking right into utility poles.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: The ashen mist's on its way here. It's scary, seeing every shade of color pale along with the land turning desolate. But that's where I'm headed anyways, because the angels of legend can light up every inch of this land—you wanna come with? Alright, hold on tight, and don't fall off my scarf this time!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: You're asking what's so fun about sitting alone in a confessional? There's oodles of fun to be had, like a maple bar in my hand, the breeze blowing in from outside, the sun shining from on high, it's perfect! Of course, there's you popping up all of a sudden. Even if you're barging in on my private moment, turns out I'm still glad you came to say hi.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: That King of Eternity said only stasis can resist oblivion. Heh, I don't think that's true. Let's go, Cyan, we'll tell Him—Apples, melodies, light, and flowers—are all way better than His lifeless soldiers for making everyone feel alive!

title: Idle
original: Lord, please bless the Leader with a long and wonderful dream, and let that dream... come true some day.

title: Idle
original: It's not seeing that's believing… it's because you believe… that you can see…

title: Onboard
original: Long time no see, Leader! Radiant as ever, aren't you? If you've got anything that needs delivering in Laterano, you come straight to me!

title: Onboard
original: Yo, li'l cyan. This entire city calls me a fool on a quest for the angels, and you seem to be the only soul who doesn't hate me. Guess you could call this destiny? Alright, I'm calling you Cyan from now on. Want an apple?

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Relax, Leader. I'm going to one-up my lame old performances in these battle records.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: So you mean, I should use my abdominal muscles to swing my lyre…

title: Promotion 1
original: Giving me such a long list? Hmm... I'm not worried about finishing it, of course. I'm worried I might do such a good job that you'll drop all your delivery work on me next time, you know?

title: Promotion 1
original: Wow! What's this? A mysterious amulet that can double your luck? Or a map that'll bring us to the angels? Thanks, Cyan!

title: Promotion 2
original: Leader, I can tell how important this thing is to you, so I swear on this gun in my hand, it'll reach its destination safely.

title: Promotion 2
original: I always feel like there's some special power in my lyre playing. What if… singing the angels' songs will turn me into one of them?! What's with the look, Cyan? A girl can dream.

title: Added to Squad
original: Relax, Leader. I'll make sure your package gets there intact. That's not what you're worried about? Oh... I get it now. Whatever you want blown up, I'll wipe it off the face of this land.

title: Added to Squad
original: Friends, let us add a new chapter to our story!

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Don't worry, just follow me and you'll never get lost, there's no place in Laterano I haven't blown up at least once... Why the face, Leader? It's easier to understand something once you crack it open for a look-see, right?

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Follow my lyre if you get lost, for I am the heraldic spearhead!

title: Depart
original: Need some lighting? All good, this light on my head will illuminate the path ahead... long as it doesn't die out. I don't think it will. Probably.

title: Depart
original: For the stories yet untold—we move!

title: Begin Operation
original: Get in line for my bullet buffet—!

title: Begin Operation
original: Ssh—The breeze's brought bards a new epic. Listen carefully.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I knew you'd come straight to me, Leader!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Let's send a little melody over to our friends!

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Uh... maybe you didn't come straight to me, but don't forget to pay my fee straight away.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: And what bardic tale are you in the mood for today?

title: Deployment 1
original: Real estate question: this wonderful realm or a panoramic view of hell—which did you want again?

title: Deployment 1
original: Now this is my stage!

title: Deployment 2
original: Okaaay... this is awkward, but I'm the only one who knows how to handle the chaos I created, haha.

title: Deployment 2
original: Let's recreate the legends, right here and now!

title: In Battle 1
original: Divine judgment, traditional!

title: In Battle 1
original: Holy Oracle!

title: In Battle 2
original: Rock n' gospel!

title: In Battle 2
original: Evangelium!

title: In Battle 3
original: Barrage sky-shattering!

title: In Battle 3
original: Music notes!

title: In Battle 4
original: Apple pie, with char siu!

title: In Battle 4
original: Honey apple pie!

title: 4-star Result
original: Yes! No place is beyond reach.

title: 4-star Result
original: I was glowing? Dunno, I was just strumming my lyre and saving lives!

title: 3-star Result
original: Leader, don't forget to invite me out for drinks on your tab, okay!

title: 3-star Result
original: A perfect curtain drop! Cyan, got that ad-libbed victory hymn written down yet?

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: No biggie. Out of bullets? Get a new mag. Gun jammed? Just use another.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Our client's still plenty happy, heheh. Cyan, let's go wrap things up and grab some grub!

title: Operation Failure
original: Ahem, I'll compensate any losses suffered during delivery, so just relax.

title: Operation Failure
original: Run, Cyan! Oh, take my lyre with you! It's worth more than my life!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: It's a little messy here... we're prepping packages to deliver—oh yeah! Leader, my hands are all full, so could you cut me some tape?

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Not a bad spot to practice my lyre.

title: Tap
original: Oh!

title: Tap
original: Woah! I just styled my hair, you know! Don't chew it off!

title: Trust Tap
original: An apple a day means seven apples a week, yay!

title: Trust Tap
original: Yo! Yet another perfect day for an adventure!

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Hey, I'm always the one making you laugh, so why don't we switch it up for New Year's? You're awfully quiet, Leader. We've fought side-by-side so many times, I'm sure you know my weak spots. Don't tell me... you don't have a clue what gets me laughing?

title: New Year's blessing
original: Wow, so lively. You can watch the magic show if you want, Cyan. I'll join you in a bit. It's a sacred day for me, so my lyre's music has to linger on the wind a little. Leaves, lakes, and light! Oh—save me a glass of cider though!

title: Greeting
original: Express delivery for you, Leader!

title: Greeting
original: Cyan, here's an apple, catch!

title: Birthday
original: Phew... I drove for two weeks plus straight, and fi... finally made it to your birthday party! Good, good, hah, this means I get to shove your face into a cake before the clock strikes twelve! So don't you hide, Leader! It's an expensive custom job, so it's not going to waste!

title: Birthday
original: Cyan, it's actually your birthday today! Look, I got the apple pies and cider here all ready! Don't give me those eyes, hey—what's wrong with taking the chance to indulge a little? Happy birthday!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Going somewhere new and meeting new friends is fun and all, but going back to your usual turf to hang out with old friends is even better. Going somewhere new with old friends? Now that's the best. So, Leader, wanna go on a trip with me?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: What exactly are angels? And why am I on a quest for them? Why do I play music? People love asking me questions, but they hate complicated answers. So, on this beautiful day, I've decided to give them the same simple answer—it's all for apple pie!
